title: Epistemic State Replication (ESR) Persistence Schema v2.0
description: Cross-agent knowledge visibility record for the H3-Tier Sovereign Runtime Substrate. v2.0 adds: (1) BLS evidence binding that cryptographically binds each validator's calibrated assurance score (c_i) to the specific Z3 safety witness; (2) sequence epoch (seq) for SEG verification; (3) SQA certificate reference inside the evidence chain. Every reasoning trajectory emitted by Manager / Researcher / Engineer / Reviewer agents is persisted as an ESR entry. Guarantees: Semantic Linearizability (every read reflects the latest committed write OR a strictly-ordered prefix) and Eventual Coherence (replicas converge within the bounded staleness window Δ).

esr_id.description: Globally unique ESR entry identifier (UUIDv7 for time-ordered).

parent_esr_id.description: If this entry is a continuation/refinement, points to the predecessor; null for seeds.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that produced this trajectory (e.g. 'manager-01', 'engineer-fpga-03').

role.description: Specialised role of the producing agent.

session_id.description: Logical session / task identifier; all ESR entries in a session form a partial order.

ts.description: Epoch-seconds timestamp of commit. Used for linearizability arbitration.

version.description: Schema version. v2 is the current release (adds BLS evidence binding, seq epoch, SQA certificate reference).

seq.description: Sequence epoch — monotonically increasing counter scoped to the session_id. The Sovereign Execution Gate rejects any mutation whose evidence_chain.seq does not match the active epoch for the session. Incremented on every epoch rotation (e.g. after a quorum reconfiguration or a Byzantine eviction).

trajectory.description: The full reasoning trajectory that produced this epistemic state.

prompt.description: The original task prompt given to the agent.

context_refs.description: ESR IDs of upstream trajectories that provided context.

tool.description: AgeMem tool invoked at this step. ADD inserts a record; UPDATE mutates the parent_rid record; DELETE tombstones the parent_rid record (soft-delete preserving ESR linearizability); RETRIEVE performs a point lookup by rid; FILTER retrieves records matching a predicate; SUMMARY condenses a window of records into a single LTM-promoted summary record; NOOP is the terminaliser.

tier.description: Memory tier targeted by the tool invocation.

content.description: Semantic content of the memory record produced/consumed.

embedding.description: Vector embedding used for retrieval (typically 16-dim in v1).

salience.description: Importance weight assigned to this record.

logprob.description: log pi(a|s) under the emitting policy.

advantage.description: Group-relative advantage after GRPO update; null before the update.

artifact_ref.description: URI of any artifact produced (RTL, script, report, etc.).

epistemic_state.description: The post-trajectory knowledge state of the agent — what it now believes to be true.

evidence_refs.description: ESR IDs of trajectories that provide evidence for this belief.

quorum.description: Semantic Quorum Assurance (SQA) certificate for this trajectory. v2.0 adds the bls_evidence_binding block that cryptographically binds each validator's calibrated assurance score (c_i) to the specific Z3 safety witness being certified.

risk_class.description: Risk classification — determines the quorum threshold function.

threshold.description: Minimum number of heterogeneous validators required for this risk class.

validators.description: List of validators that signed off on the Semantic Admissibility of this trajectory.

validator_type.description: Heterogeneous validator type — required for quorum diversity.

calibrated_assurance.description: Validator's calibrated assurance score c_i ∈ [0,1]. Cryptographically bound to the Z3 witness via bls_evidence_binding.

sig.description: BLS signature on (esr_id, verdict, validator_id, c_i, z3_witness_hash).

aggregate_sig.description: BLS aggregate signature combining all 'admit' validators' individual signatures.

admissible.description: True iff #admit >= threshold AND at least one validator of each required type signed 'admit' AND sum(c_i for admit validators) >= C_MIN (calibrated assurance floor).

bls_evidence_binding.description: Cryptographic binding between the validator assurance scores and the Z3 safety witness. Prevents evidence fabrication: a validator cannot sign off on a mutation without also signing the specific Z3 witness that certifies it.

z3_witness_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the Z3 witness model (the sat assignment) being certified. Bind to this hash prevents a validator from reusing a signature on a different witness.

binding_sig.description: BLS aggregate signature over (z3_witness_hash, [(validator_id, c_i) for admit validators]). Verifying this signature proves that the listed validators attested to the listed assurance scores for the listed witness.

c_min.description: Minimum total calibrated assurance required for this risk class. The quorum is admissible only if c_sum >= c_min.

c_sum.description: Sum of c_i over all 'admit' validators. Must be >= c_min for the quorum to be admissible.

evidence_chain.description: Intent-to-execution evidence chain carried by every Adm-gated mutation. v2.0 adds the sqa_certificate_ref and seq fields: the Sovereign Execution Gate rejects any mutation unless evidence_chain.admissible is verified against the SQA certificate (quorum.admissible) AND evidence_chain.seq matches the active sequence epoch for the session.

intent.description: The agent intent that produced this mutation.

context.description: The execution context at decision time.

epistemic_ids.description: rids currently believed-to-exist in the epistemic state.

tombstoned.description: rids that have been soft-deleted via DELETE.

logprob.description: log pi(a|s) under the emitting policy.

advantage.description: Group-relative advantage after GRPO update; null before the update.

proof_refs.description: Proof kinds carried by this reasoning trace. Must cover all kinds required by the intent (see Adm intent→proof table).

esr_evidence.description: ESR IDs of upstream trajectories that provide evidence.

admissible.description: True iff the (intent, context, action, reasoning) tuple passed the Adm evaluator's 4-rule check. The Sovereign Execution Gate cross-verifies this flag against quorum.admissible before committing the mutation.

attempts.description: Diagnostic log of the Adm-gated re-sampling loop. Each entry is 'attempt N: ADMITTED op=X' or 'attempt N: REJECTED op=X — <rule_violation>'.

sqa_certificate_ref.description: Reference to the SQA certificate (quorum block of this ESR entry) that certifies the admissibility of this evidence chain. The SEG verifies that (1) this ref points to a valid quorum block, (2) quorum.admissible is true, and (3) quorum.bls_evidence_binding.z3_witness_hash matches the Z3 witness being certified.

seq.description: Sequence epoch at the time this evidence chain was constructed. The SEG rejects the mutation if this seq does not match the active epoch for the session (top-level seq field). This prevents replay of stale evidence chains from prior epochs.

telemetry_refs.description: References to Unified Telemetry Bus snapshots that informed this trajectory.

source.description: Power island the telemetry originated from.

formal_proof_refs.description: References to Z3 / Saarthi proof artifacts that certify any safety claims made.

replication.description: Eventual-coherence bookkeeping for the ESR replication layer.

primary.description: Primary replica that first committed this entry.

lamport_ts.description: Lamport timestamp used for the Semantic Linearizability arbitration order.

staleness_bound_s.description: Maximum allowed staleness for replicas to be considered coherent (the Δ parameter).

tags.description: Free-form tags for retrieval and filtering.
